characters.Name: Aelithra
characters.Description: A slender elf with silver hair that cascades like moonlight, emerald eyes that shimmer with ancient wisdom, and delicate pointed ears that twitch at the slightest sound.

characters.Name: Brizael
characters.Description: A graceful elf with golden tresses that glow in sunlight, sapphire-blue eyes that reflect the sky, and an ethereal beauty that captivates all who gaze upon her.

characters.Name: Cylfiel
characters.Description: A tall elf with raven-black hair that flows like silk, violet eyes that hold mysterious depths, and porcelain skin that seems to glow from within.

characters.Name: Daehira
characters.Description: A petite elf with auburn curls that frame her heart-shaped face, amber eyes that sparkle with mischief, and an infectious laugh that echoes through the forests.

characters.Name: Elyndra
characters.Description: A warrior elf with muscular yet elegant frame, platinum blonde hair tied in intricate braids, piercing gray eyes that miss nothing, and numerous battle scars that tell her story.

characters.Name: Faelara
characters.Description: A curvaceous elf with chestnut brown hair adorned with flowers, hazel eyes that change color with her mood, and full lips that often curl into a knowing smile.

characters.Name: Gwyneira
characters.Description: An albino elf with snow-white hair and pale pink eyes, delicate features that seem carved from marble, and an otherworldly presence that commands silence.

characters.Name: Haldira
characters.Description: A sun-kissed elf with bronze skin, wild copper hair that crackles with energy, golden eyes that glow faintly in darkness, and toned limbs from constant travel.

characters.Name: Ilyndra
characters.Description: A regal elf with jet-black hair in an elaborate updo, sharp crimson eyes that see through deception, and perfect posture that reveals her noble heritage.

characters.Name: Jhaelira
characters.Description: A woodland elf with moss-green hair that blends with nature, deep brown eyes flecked with gold, and bark-like skin patterns that shift with the seasons.

characters.Name: Kyrithra
characters.Description: A celestial elf with hair like spun starlight, eyes that show constellations when gazed into deeply, and a voice that sounds like distant chimes.

characters.Name: Lythania
characters.Description: A water elf with teal-blue hair that flows like liquid, gills that flutter at her neck, iridescent scales that glint along her arms, and webbed fingers.

characters.Name: Myrithiel
characters.Description: A shadow elf with dark purple skin, silver-white hair that glows in moonlight, elongated canines, and claws instead of nails that shimmer like onyx.

characters.Name: Naevys
characters.Description: A twin-tailed elf with waist-length hair split into two colors - left side black, right side white - and mismatched eyes that see both past and future.

characters.Name: Olyndra
characters.Description: A jeweled elf with crystalline hair that refracts light, gemstone eyes that change color based on angle, and skin that sparkles with embedded mineral deposits.
